name: Vibraphone montuno
desc: Latin-jazz montuno played on vibraphone in Eb major - Tjader territory: broken-octave guajeo cycling I-IV-V-IV, syncopated against the 2-3 clave with the characteristic anticipated resolution; peak doubles the top octave and adds off-beat sixths.

root.doc: semitone offset from Eb major home

code.sparse: note("<[eb4 ~ g4 ~ bb4 ~ g4 ~] [~ ab4 ~ c5 ~ ab4 ~ f4]>").add(note(${root})).s("vibraphone").clip(1.5).shape(.45).gain(${gain}*.9).lpf(${cut}).pan(sine.range(.44,.56).slow(20)).room(.4).delay(.25).delaytime(.5).delayfeedback(.25).orbit(4).play()
code.full: note("<[[eb4,eb5] g4 bb4 [g4,g5] bb4 g4 [bb4,bb3] g4] [[ab4,ab3] c5 eb4 [c5,c4] eb4 c5 [ab4,ab5] c5] [[bb4,bb3] d5 f4 [d5,d4] f4 d5 [bb4,bb5] d5] [[ab4,ab3] c5 eb4 [c5,c4] eb4 [f4 g4] [ab4,ab5] c5]>").add(note(${root})).s("vibraphone").clip(1).shape(.5).gain(${gain}).lpf(${cut}).pan(sine.range(.42,.58).slow(16)).room(.35).delay(.22).delaytime(.375).delayfeedback(.22).every(8, x=>x.iter(4)).orbit(4).play()
code.peak: stack(note("<[[eb4,eb5] g4 bb4 [g4,g5] bb4 g4 [bb4,bb3] g4] [[ab4,ab3] c5 eb4 [c5,c4] eb4 c5 [ab4,ab5] c5] [[bb4,bb3] d5 f4 [d5,d4] f4 d5 [bb4,bb5] d5] [[ab4,ab3] c5 eb4 [c5,c4] eb4 [f4 g4] [ab4,ab5] c5]>").add(note(${root})).s("vibraphone").clip(.9).shape(.55).gain(${gain}).lpf(${cut}*1.1).pan(sine.range(.4,.6).slow(12)), note("<[~ [g5,bb5] ~ ~ ~ [g5,bb5] ~ ~] [~ ~ [c5,eb5] ~ ~ ~ [c5,eb5] ~]>").add(note(${root})).s("vibraphone").clip(.6).shape(.5).gain(${gain}*.55).pan(.66)).room(.32).delay(.2).delaytime(.25).delayfeedback(.2).orbit(4).play()
